technology.heading: Technology that gets out of your way
technology.body: Our digital scanner replaces messy molds with a quick 3D scan, so you can see your projected result before committing to anything — and your treatment plan adjusts precisely as your smile moves.

pricing.heading: Pricing guidance
pricing.body: Invisalign treatment typically ranges from AED 12,000–20,000 depending on complexity and length of treatment. We'll give you an exact plan and cost at your consultation.

sara.quote: I compared four clinics and this was the only one that didn't rush me into a decision.

omar.quote: The scan alone made me understand exactly what to expect before I said yes.
omar.name: Omar

hero.heading: Wondering what will happen?
hero.sub: Here's exactly what your first visit looks like.

control.heading: You're always in control.
control.body: If something feels uncomfortable, say so — we pause. You can ask us to slow down, explain again, or stop entirely at any point. Sedation and comfort options are always available if you'd like them; we'll never assume.

yearsAway.q: What if I haven't visited a dentist in years?
yearsAway.a: That's more common than you'd think, and there's no judgment here. We'll take it at your pace, starting with a conversation before anything else.

willItHurt.a: Most first visits involve no discomfort at all — it's mainly a conversation and a gentle look. If treatment is needed later, we'll always walk you through comfort options first.

canIAskToStop.a: Always. At any point, for any reason, no explanation needed.

canSomeoneComeWithMe.a: Of course — bring anyone who helps you feel more at ease.

story.heading: A different starting point
story.body: I trained believing dentistry should feel like healthcare, not a sales pitch. That's the whole reason Noor exists — a clinic built around explaining things clearly, moving at your pace, and never pushing a treatment you didn't ask about.
